scene: Car interior on a quiet road. Dad drives at screen-left, hands on the wheel and eyes on the road throughout; Child sits buckled in the back seat at screen-right, visible above the front seatback. emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: Child asks with light eager energy and one small happy wiggle of the hands; Dad answers calmly while driving; both end cheerful about the plan.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.
